Calculation Methodology

Per RA Tax Code Article 257, Turnover Tax is calculated on Gross Sales Turnover (before deducting platform or bank fees): Turnover_Tax = Gross_Turnover × Tax_Rate%. Net Monthly Income = Gross_Turnover - Turnover_Tax - (Gross_Turnover × Bank_Fee%) - Fixed_Monthly_Contributions.

REFERENCE BASIS: RA Tax Code — Turnover Tax & Individual Entrepreneur Schedule • ASSUMPTIONS VERIFIED: 2026-10-27

Reference Notes & FAQ

How is the turnover tax base defined under Article 257 of Armenia's Tax Code?

Article 257 defines the turnover tax base as gross sales turnover. Marketplace commissions (such as Upwork or Fiverr fees) and payment processor withdrawal fees do not reduce the gross turnover tax base.

Does every freelancer automatically qualify for the 1% High-Tech rate or 0% Micro-Business regime?

No. The 1% rate applies strictly to qualifying high-tech/IT activities and eligible taxpayers under the 115M AMD threshold, while the 0% micro-business regime (under 24M AMD) excludes consulting and several professional services. Verify your exact classification with a licensed Armenian accountant.
